content: Phoenix contexts are the public API boundary module for a set of related schemas (per Phoenix official contexts guide, hexdocs.pm/phoenix/contexts.html). mix phx.gen.auth (Phoenix 1.8) generates an Accounts context plus accounts/scope.ex; scopes are injected into all subsequent phx.gen.* generators to lock authorization to the current user scope. This confirms context-per-domain (Catalog, Search, RagOracle/Rulebooks, ClubOps, Accounts) is the idiomatic single-app boundary pattern, not services.
